## 1. Silent trigger death
Active is not evidence of working. n8n-io/n8n #36388, #30871, #13646, #36075 are all open. Dead-man switch over the registry.

## 2. Hung executions
n8n-io/n8n #36343 (open): workflow execution timeout is not enforced in queue mode when a node hangs. Reports only, never cancels.

## 3. Error spike
Failures per workflow inside the lookback window.

## 4. Retention and growth guard
Paged count, capped at 10 pages. Is pruning keeping up?

## 5. Definition-of-Done lint
Error workflow, timeout, owner tag, registry coverage.

## 6. Credential reference map
Note: n8n already does this. `n8n audit` reports credentials not used in a workflow, and credentials carry a Used by workflows list. This branch reimplements it so the result lands in the same findings table and severity model as the other six. See docs/07-platform-sentinel.md.

## 7. Vendor API contract probes
Status code drift against the probe registry.

## Merge, score, persist, alert
Findings dedupe by type + workflow + day. Alerts are separate: they fire on a
status CHANGE, not on every run, and a recovery is announced explicitly.
See docs/07 Part 8 for why those are two different problems.

nodes.name: Read Alert State
nodes.notes: One row, state_key=platform. Holds the last status the channel was actually told about.

nodes.name: Decide Alert
nodes.notes: GREEN->AMBER speaks. AMBER->AMBER stays quiet. AMBER->GREEN sends a recovery notice. A 24h reminder stops a long outage going silent.
